[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Radiolab (Science/Philosophy): A podcast that explores big questions and ideas through storytelling and conversation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. The Daily (News/Current Events): A daily news podcast from The New York Times, covering current events and in-depth reporting.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Conan O'Brien Needs a Friend (Comedy/Interviews): A humorous podcast where Conan O'Brien interviews celebrities, but with a twist: he's trying to find a real friend.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Hardcore History (History): In-depth, well-researched historical stories that are both engaging and informative.
